summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the immediate resignation of Chairman Daniel André Stieler from the board, effective July 6, 2026. Stieler had served as a board member since 2021 and Chairman since 2023. No financial terms, premium, or valuation were disclosed. The resignation nullifies item 1 of the extraordinary general meeting scheduled for July 22, 2026, while other items remain. The board expressed gratitude for Stieler’s governance contributions. This is an abrupt departure event. Watch for successor appointment and any strategic shifts in board composition or governance under Vale’s new leadership, as the move may influence investor sentiment and corporate direction.
